objective: Determine whether the persistent 4x5-k4 degree-2/degree-3 contradictions arise because exact component multiplicity parity itself has already identified scalar-distinct T2-O states, which would make every polynomial degree over the frozen binary component-parity coordinates insufficient.
frozenRepresentation: direct rank-local T2 with audit restricted to T2-O

antiCircularity: Every quotient key is declared before this audit is run.
Keys depend only on current-rank exact component identities, multiplicities, and rank.
Solved outcomes are consulted only to test whether a frozen structural class mixes scalar values.
No component type, modulus, or feature is selected from the identities of contradictory W/D/L rows.
falsifiersAndInterpretation: If EXACT_RANK_PARITY contains a mixed scalar-value class, then no function of exact rank and the frozen binary parity vector alone can be Q-V exact on 4x5-k4; in particular no higher square-free GF(2) polynomial degree can repair it.
If EXACT_RANK_PARITY is Q-V exact, polynomial degree above 3 remains a live explanation for the EW-RS-044 contradictions.
If EXACT_RANK_MULTIPLICITY is Q-V exact while parity is not, the obstruction is loss under count reduction rather than failure of the exact component multiset.
If EXACT_RANK_MULTIPLICITY also mixes scalar values, the current independent component multiset representation is itself Q-V insufficient on the holdout.
